remarks: Fantastic mid city townhome w/ sweeping views of downtown that few homes can offer. Within walking distance to restaurants and entertainment and train. Tri-level,3 bedroom, 2.5 bath townhouse w/ a finished 3rd level ideal for 3rd bedroom or ideal home office. Great open floor plan fireplace and deck. Unit has been completely renovated w/ custom hardwood floors, stainless steel appliances with a sunny eat-in-kitchen and underground garage parking.
